Cabinet Approves Railway Projects Worth Over Rs 20,000 Crore

The Union Cabinet has approved eight railway infrastructure projects across nine states at a total cost of Rs 20,804 crore. These projects involve multi-tracking and are aimed at improving railway connectivity and capacity. The approved projects span 2,000 kilometers of track and are expected to benefit passengers and industries by enhancing freight movement and reducing travel times. The approvals are part of a larger push to modernize and expand India's railway network.
